title: Hum dimaag ka sirf 10% use karte hain?
source: MIT McGovern Institute · Britannica · Association for Psychological Science

captions.instagram:
Sirf 10% dimaag use karte ho? Ye baat bilkul galat hai 🧠

❌ MYTH! Brain scans dikhate hain ki hum din bhar poora dimaag use karte hain. Dimaag body weight ka sirf 2% hai, par 20% energy khaata hai! 🧠

Sources: MIT McGovern Institute, Britannica, APS.
Photo: NIH via Wikimedia Commons (Public domain).

Facts checked:
• The idea that we use only 10% of our brain is a myth — MIT McGovern Institute; Britannica; APS
• We use our entire brain every day; it is constantly active, even at rest — MIT McGovern Institute; Britannica
• The brain is about 2% of body weight but uses about 20% of the body's energy (calories) — MIT McGovern Institute
• If only 10% were needed, most brain injuries would have no effect; in fact almost any damaged area causes some loss — Britannica; Wikipedia (Ten percent of the brain myth)
